title: Copy the download command for a Hugging Face model
question: How do I download all files of a Hugging Face model?
answer: Install the hf command line tool and run hf download followed by the repo name, for example hf download openai-community/gpt2; Hugging Face shows this under the three-dot menu, then Clone repository. The usermods script on this page puts that command in a copy button right under the name of every model, dataset and Space, with the --repo-type flag added for datasets and Spaces. git clone also works with Git LFS (or git-xet) installed.
prompt: On Hugging Face, add a button under the repo name that copies the hf download command for it.
details:
The script reads the repo path from the name link in the page header and builds the command: `hf download owner/name` for a model, with `--repo-type dataset` or `--repo-type space` added for datasets and Spaces. Clicking the button copies it to the clipboard. The command downloads every file in the repo into the Hugging Face cache; add `--local-dir <folder>` to put the files somewhere else.

The check loads a model's file list and a dataset page and compares the command on the button with the repo. It does not test the clipboard itself.

alternatives.title: Clone repository
alternatives.body: Open the three-dot menu next to **Use this model** and choose **Clone repository**. The dialog shows the `git clone` command and, below it, the `hf download` command with install steps for the CLI.

evidence.note: returns "hugging face download all files"; suggestions: hugging face download all files | hugging face download files

returns "huggingface cli download"; suggestions: huggingface cli download | huggingface cli download model | huggingface cli download model to local folder | huggingface cli download dataset | huggingface cli download specific quantization

check.baseline: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('h1 a.font-mono[href]'); return !!a && a.checkVisibility() && /^\/(datasets\/)?[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+$/.test(a.getAttribute('href')) && !document.querySelector('.um-hf-dl'); })()
check.expect: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('h1 + .um-hf-dl'); const want = location.pathname.startsWith('/datasets/') ? 'hf download stanfordnlp/imdb --repo-type dataset' : 'hf download openai-community/gpt2'; return document.querySelectorAll('.um-hf-dl').length === 1 && !!b && b.checkVisibility() && b.dataset.command === want && b.querySelector('code').textContent === want; })()
check.intact: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1'); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('main a[href*="/blob/"], main a[href*="/resolve/"], main table td, main .prose p')].filter((e) => e.checkVisibility()); return !!h && h.checkVisibility() && items.length >= 5; })()
